Email threat protection
Impersonation and BEC protection
Proprietary natural language processing (NLP) model analyze the text, tone, context, and structure of emails to protect from BEC and account takeover attacks.
Zero-day threat protection
Static and dynamic file analysis, including sandboxing, protects users from malicious emails by automatically detecting and blocking malware, and malicious attachments before they reach the inbox.
QR-Code and image-based protection
Protection from malicious URLs embedded by attackers within QR codes or images instead of traditional clickable links.
Anti-spam
Automatically detects and filters unwanted and unsolicited emails, keeping inboxes clean and reducing the risk of spam-borne threats.

Flexible message actions
Sophos Email gives administrators granular control over how suspicious and malicious messages are handled from instant removal to subtle user warnings.
Delete
Permanently remove confirmed malicious messages before they ever reach the user. Zero exposure, zero risk.
Admin quarantine
Hold suspicious messages for administrator review, giving your security team the final say before release or deletion.
User quarantine
Route lower-risk messages to a user-accessible quarantine, empowering recipients to review and release without IT involvement.
Smart banner
Deliver the message with a contextual warning banner that alerts users to potential risk, enabling informed decisions at the point of action.
Tag subject
Prepend a configurable tag to the email subject line to flag suspicious messages while keeping them in the normal mail flow.
Post-delivery protection
Time-of-click URL rewriting
Protects the users from the deferred weaponization of URLs by rewriting them in the delivered email. This allows the URL to be scanned at the moment the user clicks on the link, rather than when the email is delivered.
Email claw back
Post-delivery remediation allows for the automatic or manual claw back of emails from inboxes when identified as malicious post delivery, whether through updated threat intelligence or detected post-delivery weaponization.
Functionality available with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace
Data protection
Data Loss Prevention
  • Multi-rule DLP policies configurable for groups or individuals for precise control over outbound communication
  • Content Control Lists and keyword/regular expression matching for accurate detection of sensitive terms and data patterns
  • Attachment file-type analysis to prevent evasion attempts
Encryption
  • TLS Encryption for secure transport of email between mail servers
  • S/MIME support for strong, certificate-based end-to-end message protection
  • Push-based attachment and message encryption for encrypted delivery
Portal Encryption
Securely exchange sensitive emails with external parties through a branded, admin-controlled secure web portal for compliant email sharing.
  • Messages remain on the secure web portal, so sensitive data never sits in the recipient's inbox.
  • Recipients only need a browser to access encrypted emails, no complex configuration or plugins required.
  • Replies sent through the portal also remain encrypted, keeping the full conversation protected.
  • Admins can recall encrypted messages even after they've been delivered to recipients.
  • Policy-driven encryption helps organizations meet regulatory compliance requirements.

DMARC Manager
Sophos Email guides you to DMARC conformance, protecting your brand from impersonation while ensuring legitimate emails reach their intended recipients.
  • Stop attackers from impersonating your domain in phishing emails.
  • Protect brand reputation by ensuring only authorized senders can send email on your behalf.
  • DMARC conformance improves email deliverability, otherwise legitimate emails can land in junk mail or rejected.
  • Gain visibility into your email ecosystem by discovering unauthorized senders, misconfigured systems, or shadow IT.
  • Regulatory and Compliance frameworks strongly recommend DMARC as a baseline email security standard.
Phishing simulation and training
Users are the most targeted entry point for cyberattacks, with phishing and social engineering exploiting human error over technical vulnerabilities.
  • Sophos Phish Threat delivers realistic phishing simulations and interactive training that empower employees to recognize and resist threats.
  • Phishing simulations use flexible attack scenarios built from editable templates.
  • Comprehensive reporting tracks user behavior, campaign results, and training progress
  • Clear visibility into risk metrics and compliance status.
Sophos Phish Threat is included with Sophos Email at no additional cost.

Microsoft 365 integration
Deployment options
Connect via Mailflow (no MX changes, uses Exchange Connectors) or Gateway mode (MX redirection), or API-based scanning for fastest setup.
Mailflow tamper protection
Mailflow MFR Tamper Alert and Remediation monitors changes to M365 mailflow rules and connectors, alerts admins to any impact on the Mailflow setup, and automatically applies fixes.
Direct delivery
Direct Delivery bypasses Microsoft’s standard spam checks and other filtering and injects Sophos Phish Threat campaign emails directly into the recipient's inbox.
Post-delivery protection
Post-delivery remediation allows for the automatic or manual claw back of emails from inboxes when identified as malicious post delivery, whether through updated threat intelligence or detected post-delivery weaponization.
AD and Entra ID sync
Synchronizes users and mailboxes directly from Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID, keeping your protected mailbox list automatically up to date.
Encryption and DLP
Scan messages and attachments for sensitive data like PII and financial information, with encryption options including S/MIME and TLS to protect communications.

Sophos MDR Threat Case | Stopping a BEC attack
9:17 UTC
December 10, 2025
9:19 UTC
December 10, 2025
9:34 UTC
December 10, 2025
<2 minutes
Threat detected
  • Detection indicates a compromised user via a phishing campaign using WikiKit/Sneaky2fa toolkit
  • Sophos MDR observed successful authentication using valid session tokens, indicating that the user’s credentials had been harvested and reused to gain unauthorized access.
Threat remediated
As the response mode was 'Authorize’, Sophos MDR:
  • Blocked user sign-ins for the compromised account.
  • Revoked all current sessions.
Sophos MDR also revoked all active sessions in Entra ID, preventing the attacker from regaining entry even if the account is later re-enabled.
Guidance provided
  • Sophos MDR notified the customer and provided recommendations for further steps that can be taken to enhance security posture and prevent a repeat occurrence.
